params.name: resID
params.description: Resource ID number or 'id' attribute of the 'group' element (XLIFF)

params.name: strings
params.description: Strings from the STR# resource or Strings from the 'group' element (XLIFF)

params.name: resFile
params.description: Resource file reference number. If omitted: all the XLIFF files or open resources files are searched.

overloads.semanticRole: Fills the strings array with every string from a STR# resource (or, for XLIFF-based compatibility, an open XLIFF file's 'group' element) identified by resID.

constraints: If the resource is not found, the strings array is left unchanged and the OK system variable is set to 0.
_needsReview: The parameter table types resFile as 'Time', but its description ('Resource file reference number') reads like an Integer/reference-number type; kept the documented 'Time' type as-is rather than guessing at a documentation error.
